How many stages are in the orange juice process?

content.text: 1 The fruit is washed (by machines). 2 The fruit is cut into pieces. 3 Sugar is added. 4 The mixture is heated. 5 The jam is poured into jars. 6 The jars are delivered (by truck).

Overall, the production of orange juice involves ten stages, beginning with the picking of the fruit and ending with the distribution of cartons to supermarkets. One by-product, peel and pulp, is used as animal feed.
